name: infantry-default
_doc: Korean Empire (대한제국군) rifleman: near-black dark field grey uniform with red accents (collar edge, placket, cuffs, thin red trouser side stripe), flat-top kepi with team-colour band and brass plum-blossom badge. Uniform/headgear copied from infantry-default-kepi. Same body / 35 frames as the WWII variant (units/infantry-ww2.json).
